counterparty_position: 5-year survival period for all confidential information
notes: Acceptable where the relationship involves no technical disclosures. Check the disclosure scope before applying.

counterparty_position: Delaware law, exclusive jurisdiction of Delaware courts
language: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
notes: Counter to E&W first. If deal-blocking with a US counterparty, New York law without fee-shifting is the fallback at partner discretion.

language: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party with whom it had material contact in connection with this Agreement. General advertising not directed at such employees shall not constitute solicitation.
notes: We counter to 6 months and material-contact scope. 12 months is the ceiling per playbook; 6 usually lands without pushback.

counterparty_position: Oral disclosures included without written confirmation
language: Information disclosed orally shall constitute Confidential Information only if identified as confidential at the time of disclosure and summarised in writing to the Receiving Party within thirty (30) days.
notes: Standard counter. Accepted three times running without negotiation.

counterparty_position: Receiving party owns all feedback and suggestions
language: No licence or other right in any intellectual property is granted by this Agreement. Either party may use general feedback voluntarily provided by the other solely to improve its existing products, on a non-exclusive, royalty-free basis, provided such use discloses no Confidential Information.
notes: Feedback ownership is a hard no. The narrow-licence counter has landed twice; escalate if they push back on it.
Counterparty refused to remove. Senior counsel renegotiated to injunctive relief plus actual damages. Treat any liquidated damages clause as a red, no exceptions.
